title: exohebea elongata
intro: Exohebea elongata, commonly known as the "Kapok tree," is a plant species native to tropical forests in Africa. It is valued for its medicinal properties, offering several health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Exohebea elongata include wound healing, pain relief, and fever reduction. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
